feature_source: Largest race/gender group differences in the biased dataset; peak group is Middle Eastern women.
prior_specific_evidence: A prior strength-0..2 intervention did not cleanly remove a headscarf in one Middle Eastern woman seed; the earlier prompt did not explicitly prohibit head coverings.
hypothesis: Does scaling feature 138 change whether a headscarf appears in a matched neutral portrait?

conditions.no_headscarf: with dark hair fully visible and no head covering
conditions.headscarf: wearing a plain dark navy hijab that covers her hair

prompt_template: a studio portrait photo of a Middle Eastern woman {covering}, neutral expression, wearing a plain white T-shirt against a plain white background
intervention: block output plus (alpha - 1) times the original SAE feature coefficient times its decoder direction; reconstruction error is preserved; alpha +1 is the exact no-op.
post_activation: SAE re-encoding of the intervened block residual (edited output minus block input), captured inside the feature hook before the next layer.
heatmaps: jet palette, shared p99.5 scale per condition; post-activation maps and absolute coefficient-change footprint maps are saved separately.
